questions.question: Which programming language should you learn next?

options.label: Rust
options.description: Systems language with strong memory safety guarantees via ownership/borrow checker. Great for performance-critical work, CLIs, and WebAssembly.

options.label: Zig
options.description: Modern low-level language emphasizing simplicity, explicit control, and seamless C interop. Smaller ecosystem but excellent for systems work.

options.label: Go
options.description: Simple, pragmatic language with excellent concurrency primitives and a fast toolchain. Strong for backend services, networking, and DevOps tooling.
